name: c_string_escapes
description: Write standard C-style escape sequences for control characters and special string characters, with record-label copying control.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
chars={'newline':'\n','horizontal tab':'\t','carriage return':'\r','backspace':'\b','form feed':'\f','backslash':'\\','double quote':'"'}
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(98):
 name=list(chars)[i%7];label=random.choice(['alpha','beta','gamma','delta','omega','sigma'])
 p=f'String record {label}: encode a {name} inside a double-quoted C string. '
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Write only the escape sequence. Escape:', 'answer':' '+json.dumps(chars[name])[1:-1]})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'Copy the record label. Label:', 'answer':' '+label})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
